method.algorithm: Same mean-synodic-month algorithm and small-sample corrected Rayleigh approximation as model_data/evaluate_lunar_phase.py
method.representative_time: 11:00 UTC on event date; sub-day timing immaterial for this descriptive date-level test
method.episode_handling: Adjacent 1971-08-07/08 and 2026-08-29/30 dates remain collapsed; newly merged 1950-09-17 Daphne event is a new independent episode.
method.validation_limit: Event-only circular clustering. No-report days and Tier-B candidates are not negatives.

new_event.reported_time_scope: approximately 17:30 through midnight; historical clock standard unknown

decision.reason: The additional independent episode strengthens descriptive concentration modestly but remains statistically non-persuasive; zero clean matched controls prevent incremental calibration or discrimination testing. Lunar phase also cannot resolve within-date shoreline contact.
decision.promotion_requirement: Require matched event/control mornings and episode-blocked incremental scoring against seasonal, tide and transport baselines.

time_of_day_guard: The 1950 event is an evening positive. It expands occurrence evidence but must not be scored as a dawn-window forecast hit or miss until forecast_validity_window and event_onset/end semantics are explicit.
